这个数字如今称“股息支付率”。美国税法不鼓励投资者追求股息，也不鼓励公司派息，所以它较格雷厄姆时代显著下降。2002年末标普500支付率为34.1%；2000年4月更创25.3%的历史低点。第19章评论会详谈股息政策。
* Why is this? By “the rule of 72,” at 10% interest a given amount of money doubles in just over seven years, while at 7% it doubles in just over 10 years. When interest rates are high, the amount of money you need to set aside today to reach a given value in the future is lower—since those high interest rates will enable it to grow at a more rapid rate. Thus a rise in interest rates today makes a future stream of earnings or dividends less valuable—since the alternative of investing in bonds has become relatively more attractive.
原因何在？按“72法则”，利率10%时资金略多于7年翻倍，利率7%时略多于10年翻倍。利率高，要达到同一未来金额，今天需投入的钱更少，因为资金增长更快。所以当前利率上升，会降低未来盈利或股息流的价值，债券这一替代投资变得更有吸引力。

理想情况下，这些行业不会过度依赖利率波动、油或金属等原材料未来价格这类无法预测因素。可能包括博彩、化妆品、酒类、养老院或废物管理等行业。

CHAPTER 12

对每股收益的思考

Things to Consider About Per-Share Earnings

怎样识别每股收益中的一次性项目、会计选择与误导？

独立精读增强版：保留英文原文、段落 ID、词汇提示、长难句、图片及注释结构；新增完整中文译文。扩展解释均标注“译者补充（非原文）”。

Chapter 12Things to Consider About Per-Share Earnings第12章 对每股收益的思考

本章导读格雷厄姆开篇就给出两条“相互矛盾”的忠告：不要把任何单独一年的利润当真；如果非要看短期利润，就得提防每股收益数字里的陷阱。全章围绕第二条展开，拿 1970 年美国铝业公司（ALCOA）的年报做解剖：同一年的每股收益竟有四个版本（基本收益 5.20 美元、扣除特殊费用后 4.32 美元、完全稀释后 5.01 美元、稀释并扣除特殊费用后 4.19 美元），第四季度按基本收益是 1.58 美元，按净利润只有 0.70 美元，于是同一只股票的市盈率可以在 10 倍和 22 倍之间摇摆。他逐一讨论了扭曲每股收益的几类会计因素：可转换证券和认股权证造成的稀释；把未来的亏损提前打包成“特殊费用”，一次性甩进人人都已在心理上放弃的 1970 年，好让以后几年的数字显得肥美（他嘲讽这像只记录晴天时刻的日晷）；过去亏损带来的税收抵免让未来利润免税；折旧方法（直线法与加速法，Trane 公司的例子）、研发费用的处理和存货计价（先进先出与后进先出）。他还对比了两个极端：华尔街为陶氏化学 21 美分的归类小题大做，而西北工业公司相当于股价两倍的 2.64 亿美元冲销才真正影响估值——对后者，他建议先按足额纳税计算盈利能力，再为暂时的免税加一个额外的价值。结论是：公司会计常有猫腻，估值只在少数情况下真正可靠，多数投资者只要确认自己付的价格物有所值就够了。最后两小节给出两个工具：用七到十年的平均收益（把特殊项目计入其中）来熨平周期，以及用最近三年的平均数对比十年前的相应数字来计算增长率。ALCOA 的过去增长率优于西尔斯和道指，市场却只给它 11.5 倍市盈率，1959 年 116 美元的高价再也没有回来；格雷厄姆认为决定性因素可能是它平庸的资本回报率，并承认这个案例加深了他对典型工业公司估值程序可靠性的怀疑。

This chapter will begin with two pieces of advice to the investor that cannot avoid being contradictory in their implications. The first is: Don’t take a single year’s earnings seriously. The second is: If you do pay attention to short-term earnings, look out for booby traps in the per-share figures. If our first warning were followed strictly the second would be unnecessary. But it is too much to expect that most shareholders can relate all their common-stock decisions to the long-term record and the long-term prospects. The quarterly figures, and especially the annual figures, receive major attention in financial circles, and this emphasis can hardly fail to have its impact on the investor’s thinking. He may well need some education in this area, for it abounds in misleading possibilities.

If our first warning were followed strictly the second would be unnecessary. But it is too much to expect that most shareholders can relate all their common-stock decisions to the long-term record and the long-term prospects.

本章先给投资者两条含义难免矛盾的忠告。第一，不要把单一年度盈利看得太重。第二，如果确实关注短期盈利，要提防每股数字里的陷阱。若严格遵守第一条，第二条便多余；但不能指望多数股东只按长期记录和前景决定普通股买卖。季度、尤其年度数据在金融界备受关注，必然影响投资者思考。这个领域充满误导可能，投资者需要补课。

As this chapter is being written the earnings report of Aluminum Company of America (ALCOA) for 1970 appears in the Wall Street Journal. The first figures shown are

What do all these additional earnings mean? Which earnings are true earnings for the year and the December quarter? If the latter should be taken at 70 cents—the net income after special charges—the annual rate would be $2.80 instead of $6.32, and the price 62 would be “22 times earnings,” instead of the 10 times we started with.

译者补充（非原文）：同一股价62美元，若用年化6.32美元盈利，市盈率约9.8倍；若用2.80美元，则约22.1倍。分母口径会让“便宜”瞬间变成“昂贵”。

Part of the question as to the “true earnings” of ALCOA can be answered quite easily. The reduction from $5.20 to $5.01, to allow for the effects of “dilution,” is clearly called for. ALCOA has a large bond issue convertible into common stock; to calculate the “earning power” of the common, based on the 1970 results, it must be assumed that the conversion privilege will be exercised if it should prove profitable to the bondholders to do so. The amount involved in the ALCOA picture is relatively small, and hardly deserves detailed comment. But in other cases, making allowance for conversion rights—and the existence of stock-purchase warrants—can reduce the apparent earnings by half, or more. We shall present examples of a really significant dilution factor below (page 411). (The financial services are not always consistent in their allowance for the dilution factor in their reporting and analyses.)*

to allow for为了把……考虑在内dilution稀释（可转换证券转股后每股收益被摊薄）convertible into common stock可转换为普通股的is clearly called for显然是必要的earning power盈利能力conversion privilege转换权exercised行使（权利）making allowance for考虑到，为……留出余地stock-purchase warrants认股权证the financial services金融信息服务机构（如穆迪、标普等提供数据和分析的公司）

美国铝业“真实盈利”的一部分问题很容易回答。考虑“摊薄”影响，把5.20降至5.01美元显然必要。公司有大量可转普通股债券；按1970年结果计算普通股“盈利能力”，必须假定只要对债券持有人有利，转换权就会行使。本例金额较小，不值得细讲；其他案例中，转换权和认股权证可能让表面盈利减少一半以上，后文第411页会举真正重大的摊薄例子。（金融资讯机构在报告和分析中并不总以一致方式处理摊薄。）

Let us turn now to the matter of “special charges.” This figure of $18,800,000, or 88 cents per share, deducted in the fourth quarter, is not unimportant. Is it to be ignored entirely, or fully recognized as an earnings reduction, or partly recognized and partly ignored? The alert investor might ask himself also how does it happen that there was a virtual epidemic of such special charge-offs appearing after the close of 1970, but not in previous years? Could there possibly have been some fine Italian hands† at work with the accounting—but always, of course, within the limits of the permissible? When we look closely we may find that such losses, charged off before they actually occur, can be charmed away, as it were, with no unhappy effect on either past or future “primary earnings.” In some extreme cases they might be availed of to make subsequent earnings appear nearly twice as large as in reality—by a more or less prestidigitous treatment of the tax credit involved.

Could there possibly have been some fine Italian hands at work with the accounting—but always, of course, within the limits of the permissible?

会不会有人在账目上暗中做了些精巧的手脚——当然，始终是在规则允许的范围之内？

fine Italian hand 是英语习语，指精巧而不露痕迹的操纵手法；Could there possibly have been… 是对过去情况的推测性反问。the permissible 是“the + 形容词”表示抽象概念的用法，意为“被允许的范围”。

再看“特殊费用”。第四季度扣除1880万美元，即每股88美分，并非小数。应完全忽略、全部视为盈利减少，还是部分承认？警觉的投资者还会问：为什么1970年末以后这类特殊核销几乎像流行病一样出现，以前却没有？会计上是否有精巧手法在运作，当然都在允许范围内？细看会发现，实际发生前就核销的损失，可能像变魔术一样，不影响过去或未来的“基本盈利”。极端情况下，再利用相关税收抵免的障眼法，甚至能让随后盈利看起来接近实际两倍。

All of these items are related to future costs and losses. It is easy to say that they are not part of the “regular operating results” of 1970—but if so, where do they belong? Are they so “extraordinary and nonrecurring” as to belong nowhere? A widespread enterprise such as ALCOA, doing a $1.5 billion business annually, must have a lot of divisions, departments, affiliates, and the like. Would it not be normal rather than extraordinary for one or more to prove unprofitable, and to require closing down? Similarly for such things as a contract to build a wall. Suppose that any time a company had a loss on any part of its business it had the bright idea of charging it off as a “special item,” and thus reporting its “primary earnings” per share so as to include only its profitable contracts and operations? Like King Edward VII’s sundial, that marked only the “sunny hours.”*

regular operating results正常经营业绩extraordinary and nonrecurring非常规且不会再发生的（会计上“非经常性项目”的标准说法）as to belong nowhere以至于哪儿都不属于（so… as to…：如此……以至于……）widespread enterprise业务铺得很广的企业affiliates关联公司，附属公司and the like等等，诸如此类prove unprofitable结果证明不盈利bright idea妙主意（此处是反语）sundial日晷sunny hours阳光灿烂的时刻（日晷上的常见铭文，讽刺只记好事）

Suppose that any time a company had a loss on any part of its business it had the bright idea of charging it off as a “special item,” and thus reporting its “primary earnings” per share so as to include only its profitable contracts and operations? Like King Edward VII’s sundial, that marked only the “sunny hours.”

试想，假如一家公司任何时候在任何一块业务上出现亏损，都灵机一动把它作为“特殊项目”核销掉，从而让报告的每股“基本收益”只包含赚钱的合同和业务，那会怎样？这就像爱德华七世的日晷，只记录“阳光灿烂的时刻”。

Suppose that… 引导假设，句末用问号，相当于“要是……会怎样？”；any time (that) a company had a loss… 是时间状语从句，主句是 it had the bright idea…，bright idea 在此是反语。日晷上常刻的铭文是“我只记录晴天的时光”，格雷厄姆借此讽刺只报好消息的做账方式。

这些全与未来成本和损失有关。说它们不属于1970年“正常经营结果”很容易，可又该归到哪里？难道“异常且不再发生”到无处可归？美国铝业年收入15亿美元，部门、分支和关联公司众多，其中一两个亏损并需关闭，应属正常而非异常；承建幕墙合同亏损也一样。若公司任何业务一亏，就作为“特殊项目”核销，让“基本每股盈利”只包括赚钱的合同和业务，那就像爱德华七世的日晷，只记录“阳光时刻”。

The reader should note two ingenious aspects of the ALCOA procedure we have been discussing. The first is that by anticipating future losses the company escapes the necessity of allocating the losses themselves to an identifiable year. They don’t belong in 1970, because they were not actually taken in that year. And they won’t be shown in the year when they are actually taken, because they have already been provided for. Neat work, but might it not be just a little misleading?

ingenious巧妙的（此处带讽刺）anticipating提前计入，预先估计actually taken实际发生、实际确认（会计上“承担”损失）provided for已经计提（预先留出准备）Neat work干得漂亮（反语）

这种处理有两个巧妙处。第一，提前确认未来损失，便不用把实际损失分配到某个可识别年度：它不属于1970年，因为当年尚未发生；实际发生之年也不显示，因为早已计提。做得很利落，但是否也有一点误导？

The ALCOA footnote says nothing about the future tax saving from these losses. (Most other statements of this sort state specifically that only the “after-tax effect” has been charged off.) If the ALCOA figure represents future losses before the related tax credit, then not only will future earnings be freed from the weight of these charges (as they are actually incurred), but they will be increased by a tax credit of some 50% thereof. It is difficult to believe that the accounts will be handled that way. But it is a fact that certain companies which have had large losses in the past have been able to report future earnings without charging the normal taxes against them, in that way making a very fine profits appearance indeed—based paradoxically enough on their past disgraces. (Tax credits resulting from past years’ losses are now being shown separately as “special items,” but they will enter into future statistics as part of the final “net-income” figure. However, a reserve now set up for future losses, if net of expected tax credit, should not create an addition of this sort to the net income of later years.)

statements of this sort这类财务报表（statement 此处指财报）after-tax effect税后影响freed from the weight of摆脱……的负担incurred发生（费用、损失）some 50% thereof其中约 50%（thereof = of it）charging the normal taxes against them从利润中扣除正常的税负paradoxically enough说来矛盾的是disgraces耻辱（此处指过去的亏损）enter into计入，成为……的一部分reserve准备金net of扣除……之后的净额

But it is a fact that certain companies which have had large losses in the past have been able to report future earnings without charging the normal taxes against them, in that way making a very fine profits appearance indeed—based paradoxically enough on their past disgraces.

但事实是，某些过去亏损巨大的公司，后来报告利润时可以不扣除正常的税负，从而做出一副非常漂亮的盈利面貌——而这，说来矛盾，恰恰建立在它们过去的耻辱之上。

that 从句的主语是 certain companies，中间插入定语从句 which have had large losses in the past，谓语是 have been able to report；in that way making… 是分词短语表示结果；based paradoxically enough on… 补充说明这种“漂亮面貌”的来源，paradoxically enough 意为“说来矛盾的是”。

脚注没有说明未来损失带来的节税。如果计提的是税收抵免前损失，那么费用实际发生时，未来盈利不仅不再负担它，还会增加约相当于损失50%的税收抵免。很难相信账目真会如此处理，但确有公司因过去巨亏，未来报告盈利时无需扣正常税款，反而凭昔日耻辱呈现漂亮利润。（过去亏损形成的税收抵免现在会单列为“特殊项目”，但未来统计仍进入最终净利润；若当前未来损失准备已扣除预期抵免，则不应再给以后净利润增加同类项目。）

The other ingenious feature is the use by ALCOA and many other companies of the 1970 year-end for making these special charge-offs. The stock market took what appeared to be a blood bath in the first half of 1970. Everyone expected relatively poor results for the year for most companies. Wall Street was now anticipating better results in 1971, 1972, etc. What a nice arrangement, then, to charge as much as possible to the bad year, which had already been written off mentally and had virtually receded into the past, leaving the way clear for nicely fattened figures in the next few years! Perhaps this is good accounting, good business policy, and good for management-shareholder relationships. But we have lingering doubts.

year-end年末，年终blood bath血洗，大屠杀（指股市暴跌）written off mentally在心理上已经被一笔勾销receded into the past退入过去，成为往事leaving the way clear for为……扫清道路fattened被养肥的，被做大的lingering doubts挥之不去的疑虑

What a nice arrangement, then, to charge as much as possible to the bad year, which had already been written off mentally and had virtually receded into the past, leaving the way clear for nicely fattened figures in the next few years!

那么，把尽可能多的费用都记到那个糟糕的年份——它早已被人们在心理上一笔勾销、几乎已经成为过去——从而为今后几年养得肥肥的数字扫清道路，这安排真是太妙了！

What a nice arrangement… to charge… 是感叹句，不定式 to charge 说明“安排”的内容；which 引导的非限定性定语从句修饰 the bad year；leaving… 是分词短语表示结果。整句是反语，“妙”其实是“太会算计了”。

第二个巧妙处，是美国铝业及许多公司选在1970年末作特殊核销。1970年上半年股市仿佛经历血洗，人人预期多数公司全年成绩差；华尔街已经展望1971、1972年改善。把尽可能多的费用塞进这个心理上已被放弃、几乎成为过去的坏年份，正好为随后几年更丰满的数字清路。也许这是好会计、好经营政策，也有利管理层与股东关系，但我们仍有疑虑。

The combination of widely (or should it be wildly?) diversified operations with the impulse to clean house at the end of 1970 has produced some strange-looking footnotes to the annual reports. The reader may be amused by the following explanation given by a New York Stock Exchange company (which shall remain unnamed) of its “special items” aggregating $2,357,000, or about a third of the income before charge-offs: “Consists of provision for closing Spalding United Kingdom operations; provision for reorganizational expenses of a division; costs of selling a small babypants and bib manufacturing company, disposing of part interest in a Spanish car-leasing facility, and liquidation of a ski-boot operation.”*

wildly狂野地，胡乱地（与 widely 谐音双关：多元化得太“野”了）the impulse to clean house大扫除的冲动（指年末把坏账一次清理干净）which shall remain unnamed此处隐去其名provision for为……计提的准备金babypants and bib婴儿裤和围嘴disposing of part interest in出售在……中的部分股权liquidation清算，清盘

广泛（或者说疯狂）多元化经营，加上1970年末“大扫除”的冲动，让年报脚注出现奇景。一家不点名的纽交所公司解释235.7万美元“特殊项目”（约占核销前利润三分之一）如下：“包括关闭英国斯伯丁业务的准备；某部门重组费用准备；出售一家小型婴儿裤和围嘴制造商、处置一家西班牙汽车租赁机构部分权益，以及清算滑雪靴业务的成本。”

Years ago the strong companies used to set up “contingency reserves” out of the profits of good years to absorb some of the bad effects of depression years to come. The underlying idea was to equalize the reported earnings, more or less, and to improve the stability factor in the company’s record. A worthy motive, it would seem; but the accountants quite rightly objected to the practice as misstating the true earnings. They insisted that each year’s results be presented as they were, good or bad, and the shareholders and analysts be allowed to do the averaging or equalizing for themselves. We seem now to be witnessing the opposite phenomenon, with everyone charging off as much as possible against forgotten 1970, so as to start 1971 with a slate not only clean but specially prepared to show pleasing per-share figures in the coming years.

They insisted that each year’s results be presented as they were, good or bad, and the shareholders and analysts be allowed to do the averaging or equalizing for themselves.

多年前，实力强的公司会在好年份从利润中设“或有准备”，吸收未来萧条年份的影响，意在平滑报告盈利、提高记录稳定性。动机似乎正当，会计师却正确反对，因为它歪曲真实盈利；每年好坏应如实呈现，由股东和分析师自己平均。如今似乎出现相反现象：人人尽量把费用记在被遗忘的1970年，让1971年从一块不仅干净、还特别适合展示漂亮每股数字的白板开始。

It is time to return to our first question. What then were the true earnings of ALCOA in 1970? The accurate answer would be: The $5.01 per share, after “dilution,” less that part of the 82 cents of “special charges” that may properly be attributed to occurrences in 1970. But we do not know what that portion is, and hence we cannot properly state the true earnings for the year. The management and the auditors should have given us their best judgment on this point, but they did not do so. And furthermore, the management and the auditors should have provided for deduction of the balance of these charges from the ordinary earnings of a suitable number of future years—say, not more than five. This evidently they will not do either, since they have already conveniently disposed of the entire sum as a 1970 special charge.

回到最初问题：美国铝业1970年真实盈利多少？准确回答应是：摊薄后的每股5.01美元，减去82美分“特殊费用”中真正属于1970年事件的部分。但我们不知道这部分多少，无法正确陈述。管理层和审计师本应给出最佳判断，却没有；还应把其余费用从未来适当若干年（最多五年）的正常盈利中扣除，显然也不会，因为全部金额已方便地当作1970年特殊费用处理。

The more seriously investors take the per-share earnings figures as published, the more necessary it is for them to be on their guard against accounting factors of one kind and another that may impair the true comparability of the numbers. We have mentioned three sorts of these factors: the use of special charges, which may never be reflected in the per-share earnings, the reduction in the normal income-tax deduction by reason of past losses, and the dilution factor implicit in the existence of substantial amounts of convertible securities or warrants.1 A fourth item that has had a significant effect on reported earnings in the past is the method of treating depreciation—chiefly as between the “straight-line” and the “accelerated” schedules. We refrain from details here. But as an example current as we write, let us mention the 1970 report of Trane Co. This firm showed an increase of nearly 20% in per-share earnings over 1969—$3.29 versus $2.76—but half of this came from returning to the older straight-line depreciation rates, less burdensome on earnings than the accelerated method used the year before. (The company will continue to use the accelerated rate on its income-tax return, thus deferring income-tax payments on the difference.) Still another factor, important at times, is the choice between charging off research and development costs in the year they are incurred or amortizing them over a period of years. Finally, let us mention the choice between the FIFO (first-in-first-out) and LIFO (last-in-first-out) methods of valuing inventories.*

投资者越认真看待公布的每股盈利，就越要警惕破坏数字可比性的会计因素。我们已提三类：可能永不反映在每股盈利中的特殊费用；过去亏损导致正常所得税扣除减少；大量可转证券或认股权证隐含的摊薄。第四项是折旧处理，主要是直线法与加速法之别。这里不详述。写作时的例子是特灵公司1970年每股盈利比1969年增近20%，从2.76到3.29美元；但一半增幅来自改回较老的直线折旧，负担小于上年加速折旧。（报税仍用加速法，从而递延差额税款。）还有研发费用是当年核销还是多年摊销，以及存货采用先进先出还是后进先出，也会影响报告盈利。

An obvious remark here would be that investors should not pay any attention to these accounting variables if the amounts involved are relatively small. But Wall Street being as it is, even items quite minor in themselves can be taken seriously. Two days before the ALCOA report appeared in the Wall Street Journal, the paper had quite a discussion of the corresponding statement of Dow Chemical. It closed with the observation that “many analysts” had been troubled by the fact that Dow had included a 21-cent item in regular profits for 1969, instead of treating it as an item of “extraordinary income.” Why the fuss? Because, evidently, evaluations of Dow Chemical involving many millions of dollars in the aggregate seemed to depend on exactly what was the percentage gain for 1969 over 1968—in this case either 9% or 4½%. This strikes us as rather absurd; it is very unlikely that small differences involved in one year’s results could have any bearing on future average profits or growth, and on a conservative, realistic valuation of the enterprise.

显然，金额很小时投资者不必理会这些变量；可华尔街连很小项目也会认真对待。美国铝业报告前两天，《华尔街日报》讨论陶氏化学报表，最后说“许多分析师”不安，因为陶氏把1969年21美分计入正常利润，而非“非经常收入”。为何大惊小怪？显然，涉及陶氏数百万美元的估值，似乎取决于1969年比1968年究竟增长9%还是4.5%。这颇荒唐：单年如此小的差异，极不可能影响未来平均利润、增长或企业保守而现实的估值。

By contrast, consider another statement also appearing in January 1971. This concerned Northwest Industries Inc.’s report for 1970.* The company was planning to write off, as a special charge, not less than $264 million in one fell swoop. Of this, $200 million represents the loss to be taken on the proposed sale of the railroad subsidiary to its employees and the balance a write-down of a recent stock purchase. These sums would work out to a loss of about $35 per share of common before dilution offsets, or twice its then current market price. Here we have something really significant. If the transaction goes through, and if the tax laws are not changed, this loss provided for in 1970 will permit Northwest Industries to realize about $400 million of future profits (within five years) from its other diversified interests without paying income tax thereon.* What will then be the real earnings of that enterprise; should they be calculated with or without provision for the nearly 50% in income taxes which it will not actually have to pay? In our opinion, the proper mode of calculation would be first to consider the indicated earning power on the basis of full income-tax liability, and to derive some broad idea of the stock’s value based on that estimate. To this should be added some bonus figure, representing the value per share of the important but temporary tax exemption the company will enjoy. (Allowance must be made, also, for a possible large-scale dilution in this case. Actually, the convertible preferred issues and warrants would more than double the outstanding common shares if the privileges are exercised.)

All this may be confusing and wearisome to our readers, but it belongs in our story. Corporate accounting is often tricky; security analysis can be complicated; stock valuations are really dependable only in exceptional cases.† For most investors it would be probably best to assure themselves that they are getting good value for the prices they pay, and let it go at that.

这一切也许让读者困惑疲倦，但确属主题。公司会计常有花招，证券分析可能复杂，股票估值只有极少数情况下真正可靠。多数投资者最好只确认自己付出的价格能买到好价值，到此为止。

译者补充（非原文）：这里不是要求普通投资者精通所有会计规则，而是提醒：遇到口径反复调整、脚注远长于主表时，要提高安全边际或放弃。

Use of Average Earnings

平均收益的运用

In former times analysts and investors paid considerable attention to the average earnings over a fairly long period in the past—usually from seven to ten years. This “mean figure”* was useful for ironing out the frequent ups and downs of the business cycle, and it was thought to give a better idea of the company’s earning power than the results of the latest year alone. One important advantage of such an averaging process is that it will solve the problem of what to do about nearly all the special charges and credits. They should be included in the average earnings. For certainly most of these losses and gains represent a part of the company’s operating history. If we do this for ALCOA, the average earnings for 1961–1970 (ten years) would appear as $3.62 and for the seven years 1964–1970 as $4.62 per share. If such figures are used in conjunction with ratings for growth and stability of earnings during the same period, they could give a really informing picture of the company’s past performance.

过去，分析师和投资者很重视较长时期、通常七至十年的平均盈利。“平均数”能熨平商业周期的频繁起落，被认为比单一最新年度更能说明盈利能力。平均还有一大好处：几乎所有特殊费用和收益都应纳入，因为它们大多属于公司经营史。这样计算，美国铝业1961—1970年十年平均每股3.62美元，1964—1970年七年平均4.62美元。再结合同期盈利增长和稳定性评级，就能相当清楚地呈现过去表现。

Calculation of the Past Growth Rate

过去增长率的计算

It is of prime importance that the growth factor in a company’s record be taken adequately into account. Where the growth has been large the recent earnings will be well above the seven-or ten-year average, and analysts may deem these long-term figures irrelevant. This need not be the case. The earnings can be given in terms both of the average and the latest figure. We suggest that the growth rate itself be calculated by comparing the average of the last three years with corresponding figures ten years earlier. (Where there is a problem of “special charges or credits” it may be dealt with on some compromise basis.) Note the following calculation for the growth of ALCOA as against that of Sears Roebuck and the DJIA group as a whole.

公司记录中的增长因素必须得到充分考虑。增长很快时，近期盈利会远高于七年或十年平均，分析师可能认为长期数字无关；其实可以同时给出平均和最新数字。我们建议比较最近三年平均与十年前对应数字，计算增长率；特殊费用或收益可用折中方式处理。下面比较美国铝业、西尔斯以及道指整体的增长。

Comment: These few figures could be made the subject of a long discussion. They probably show as well as any others, derived by elaborate mathematical treatment, the actual growth of earnings for the long period 1958–1970. But how relevant is this figure, generally considered central in common-stock valuations, to the case of ALCOA? Its past growth rate was excellent, actually a bit better than that of acclaimed Sears Roebuck and much higher than that of the DJIA composite. But the market price at the beginning of 1971 seemed to pay no attention to this fine performance. ALCOA sold at only 11½ times the recent three-year average, while Sears sold at 27 times and the DJIA itself at 15+ times. How did this come about? Evidently Wall Street has fairly pessimistic views about the future course of ALCOA’s earnings, in contrast with its past record. Surprisingly enough, the high price for ALCOA was made as far back as 1959. In that year it sold at 116, or 45 times its earnings. (This compares with a 1959 adjusted high price of 25½ for Sears Roebuck, or 20 times its then earnings.) Even though ALCOA’s profits did show excellent growth thereafter, it is evident that in this case the future possibilities were greatly overestimated in the market price. It closed 1970 at exactly half of the 1959 high, while Sears tripled in price and the DJIA moved up nearly 30%.

这几项数字足以长篇讨论。它们对1958—1970年长期实际盈利增长的说明，可能不逊于复杂数学结果。但这个普通股估值核心数字，对美国铝业究竟多相关？其过去增长优秀，略胜备受赞誉的西尔斯，远高于道指；1971年初市价却似乎不理会：美国铝业仅为近三年平均盈利11.5倍，西尔斯27倍，道指逾15倍。显然华尔街对美国铝业未来盈利悲观。奇怪的是，其股价高点早在1959年，当年116美元，相当于45倍盈利；西尔斯调整后高点25.5美元，仅20倍。美国铝业后来利润虽增长优秀，1959年价格仍明显高估未来；1970年末股价仅为高点一半，西尔斯却涨到三倍，道指升近30%。

Let us apply at this point to ALCOA the suggestion we made in the previous chapter for a “two-part appraisal process.”* Such an approach might have produced a “past-performance value” for ALCOA of 10% of the DJIA, or $84 per share relative to the closing price of 840 for the DJIA in 1970. On this basis the shares would have appeared quite attractive at their price of 57¼.

现在把上一章建议的“两部分估值法”用于美国铝业。按过去业绩，价值也许相当于道指的10%；1970年道指收840点，即每股84美元。与57.25美元市价相比，股票看起来相当有吸引力。

To what extent should the senior analyst have marked down the “past-performance value” to allow for adverse developments that he saw in the future? Frankly, we have no idea. Assume he had reason to believe that the 1971 earnings would be as low as $2.50 per share—a large drop from the 1970 figure, as against an advance expected for the DJIA. Very likely the stock market would take this poor performance quite seriously, but would it really establish the once mighty Aluminum Company of America as a relatively unprofitable enterprise, to be valued at less than its tangible assets behind the shares?† (In 1971 the price declined from a high of 70 in May to a low of 36 in December, against a book value of 55.)

ALCOA is surely a representative industrial company of huge size, but we think that its price-and-earnings history is more unusual, even contradictory, than that of most other large enterprises. Yet this instance supports to some degree, the doubts we expressed in the last chapter as to the dependability of the appraisal procedure when applied to the typical industrial company.

美国铝业无疑是规模巨大的代表性工业公司，但其价格与盈利历史比多数大企业更反常、甚至矛盾。这个案例在一定程度上支持上一章的疑虑：把估值程序用于典型工业公司，可靠性有限。

Notes · 注释（贾森·兹威格）

* “Dilution” is one of many words that describe stocks in the language of fluid dynamics. A stock with high trading volume is said to be “liquid.” When a company goes public in an IPO, it “floats” its shares. And, in earlier days, a company that drastically diluted its shares (with large amounts of convertible debt or multiple offerings of common stock) was said to have “watered” its stock. This term is believed to have originated with the legendary market manipulator Daniel Drew (1797–1879), who began as a livestock trader. He would drive his cattle south toward Manhattan, force-feeding them salt along the way. When they got to the Harlem River, they would guzzle huge volumes of water to slake their thirst. Drew would then bring them to market, where the water they had just drunk would increase their weight. That enabled him to get a much higher price, since cattle on the hoof is sold by the pound. Drew later watered the stock of the Erie Railroad by massively issuing new shares without warning.
“摊薄”是股票语言中众多流体力学词汇之一。交易活跃的股票叫“流动性好”；公司IPO叫股份“上市流通”；早年大量可转债或多次增发严重摊薄股份，叫把股票“注水”。据说词源来自传奇操纵者、牲畜商丹尼尔·德鲁：他赶牛去曼哈顿途中强喂盐，牛到哈莱姆河大量喝水，上市时体重变大、售价更高。后来他也通过毫无预警地巨量增发给伊利铁路股票“注水”。
† Graham is referring to the precise craftsmanship of the immigrant Italian stone carvers who ornamented the otherwise plain facades of buildings throughout New York in the early 1900s. Accountants, likewise, can transform simple financial facts into intricate and even incomprehensible patterns.
格雷厄姆借指20世纪初装饰纽约朴素建筑立面的意大利移民石雕匠，其工艺精细；会计师同样能把简单财务事实变成复杂甚至难懂的图案。
* The king probably took his inspiration from a once-famous essay by the English writer William Hazlitt, who mused about a sundial near Venice that bore the words Horas non numero nisi serenas, or “I count only the hours that are serene.” Companies that chronically exclude bad news from their financial results on the pretext that negative events are “extraordinary” or “nonrecurring” are taking a page from Hazlitt, who urged his readers “to take no note of time but by its benefits, to watch only for the smiles and neglect the frowns of fate, to compose our lives of bright and gentle moments, turning away to the sunny side of things, and letting the rest slip from our imaginations, unheeded or forgotten!” (William Hazlitt, “On a Sun-Dial,” ca.1827.) Unfortunately, investors must always count the sunny and dark hours alike.
国王的灵感可能来自威廉·赫兹里特谈威尼斯附近日晷的文章，日晷刻着“我只计算晴朗的时刻”。长期以“异常”或“不再发生”为由排除坏消息的公司，也是在效仿这种只看命运微笑、忽略皱眉的做法。可惜投资者必须同样计算晴天和阴天。
* The company to which Graham refers so coyly appears to be American Machine & Foundry (or AMF Corp.), one of the most jumbled conglomerates of the late 1960s. It was a predecessor of today’s AMF Bowling Worldwide, which operates bowling alleys and manufactures bowling equipment.
格雷厄姆含蓄指的公司似乎是美国机器铸造公司（AMF），20世纪60年代末业务最混乱的综合企业之一，也是今天经营保龄球馆、制造设备的AMF Bowling Worldwide前身。
* Nowadays, investors need to be aware of several other “accounting factors” that can distort reported earnings. One is “pro forma” or “as if” financial statements, which report a company’s earnings as if Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) did not apply. Another is the dilutive effect of issuing millions of stock options for executive compensation, then buying back millions of shares to keep those options from reducing the value of the common stock. A third is unrealistic assumptions of return on the company’s pension funds, which can artificially inflate earnings in good years and depress them in bad. Another is “Special Purpose Entities,” or affiliated firms or partnerships that buy risky assets or liabilities of the company and thus “remove” those financial risks from the company’s balance sheet. Another element of distortion is the treatment of marketing or other “soft” costs as assets of the company, rather than as normal expenses of doing business. We will briefly examine such practices in the commentary that accompanies this chapter.
如今还要警惕更多扭曲盈利的会计因素：不按公认会计原则的“备考”报表；向高管发行数百万期权后再回购股票抵销摊薄；不现实的养老金回报假设；用特殊目的实体承接风险资产或负债，把风险移出资产负债表；把营销等“软成本”资本化而非计作正常费用。本章评论会简要讨论。
* Northwest Industries was the holding company for, among other businesses, the Chicago and Northwestern Railway Co. and Union Underwear (the maker of both BVD and Fruit of the Loom briefs). It was taken over in 1985 by overindebted financier William Farley, who ran the company into the ground. Fruit of the Loom was bought in a bankruptcy proceeding by Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway Inc. in early 2002.
西北工业是芝加哥与西北铁路、联合内衣等公司的控股公司。1985年被高负债金融家威廉·法利收购后经营垮掉；Fruit of the Loom于2002年初破产程序中被巴菲特的伯克希尔哈撒韦买下。
* Graham is referring to the provision of Federal tax law that allows corporations to “carry forward” their net operating losses. As the tax code now stands, these losses can be carried forward for up to 20 years, reducing the company’s tax liability for the entire period (and thus raising its earnings after tax). Therefore, investors should consider whether recent severe losses could actually improve the company’s net earnings in the future.
美国联邦税法允许公司把净经营亏损“向后结转”；按当时税法最长20年，可降低整个期间税负并提高税后盈利。因此投资者应考虑，近期巨亏是否反而改善未来净利润。
† Investors should keep these words at hand and remind themselves of them frequently: “Stock valuations are really dependable only in exceptional cases.” While the prices of most stocks are approximately right most of the time, the price of a stock and the value of its business are almost never identical. The market’s judgment on price is often unreliable. Unfortunately, the margin of the market’s pricing errors is often not wide enough to justify the expense of trading on them. The intelligent investor must carefully evaluate the costs of trading and taxes before attempting to take advantage of any price discrepancy—and should never count on being able to sell for the exact price currently quoted in the market.
投资者应常提醒自己：“股票估值只有极少数情况下真正可靠。”多数股票价格多数时候大致正确，但股价与企业价值几乎从不完全相同。市场判断常不可靠，可定价错误又往往不够大，不足以弥补交易成本。利用价差前必须计算交易费和税，也绝不能认定能按当前报价精确卖出。
* “Mean figure” refers to the simple, or arithmetic, average that Graham describes in the preceding sentence.
“平均数”指上一句所说的简单算术平均。
a Three-fifths of special charges of 82 cents in 1970 deducted here.
此处扣除了1970年82美分特殊费用的五分之三。
* Graham appears to be using “earnings on capital funds” in the traditional sense of return on book value—essentially, net income divided by the company’s tangible net assets.
格雷厄姆似乎按传统含义使用“资本资金盈利”，即账面价值回报率，基本等于净利润除以公司有形净资产。
* See pp. 299–301.
见第299—301页。
† Recent history—and a mountain of financial research—have shown that the market is unkindest to rapidly growing companies that suddenly report a fall in earnings. More moderate and stable growers, as ALCOA was in Graham’s day or Anheuser-Busch and Colgate-Palmolive are in our time, tend to suffer somewhat milder stock declines if they report disappointing earnings. Great expectations lead to great disappointment if they are not met; a failure to meet moderate expectations leads to a much milder reaction. Thus, one of the biggest risks in owning growth stocks is not that their growth will stop, but merely that it will slow down. And in the long run, that is not merely a risk, but a virtual certainty.
近代历史和大量研究表明，快速成长公司一旦突然报告盈利下滑，市场最不留情；增长较温和稳定的公司报告失望盈利，股价下跌通常较轻。期望越大，未实现时失望越大；未达到温和预期，反应也温和。因此持有成长股的一大风险并非增长停止，只是增长放缓；长期看，放缓几乎必然发生。

四家上市公司的比较

A Comparison of Four Listed Companies

Chapter 13A Comparison of Four Listed Companies第13章 四家上市公司的比较

本章导读本章是格雷厄姆的一次“现场示范”：他从纽约证券交易所的名单上，几乎随手挑出按字母顺序紧挨着的四家公司——ELTRA、艾默生电气、埃默里航空货运和埃姆哈特——用同一套指标逐项比较，展示证券分析实际上是怎么做的。最扎眼的发现是：四家公司市盈率的差距（9.7 倍、12 倍对 33 倍、45 倍）远比它们经营业绩和财务状况的差距大得多；市场给出高估值的理由，是艾默生和埃默里近年更快的盈利增长。随后他按盈利能力、稳定性、增长、财务状况、股息记录、价格历史六个方面逐一检查，发现“便宜的一对”在统计数据上其实表现得出人意料地好，只是缺少“魅力”。在总体观察部分，他用齐尼斯无线电的先例提醒读者“高估值意味着高风险”，并指出埃默里的高增长起点很小、未来未必能延续。结论部分给出本章最值得记住的原则：股价走势本身不是稳健投资者选股的理由，增长有价值但要有限度；ELTRA 和埃姆哈特具备“价格背后有足够价值支撑”的特征，满足他为防御型投资者列出的七条统计标准（足够的规模、稳健的财务、20 年连续派息、10 年无亏损、10 年盈利增长至少三分之一、股价不超过净资产的 1.5 倍、市盈率不超过 15 倍）。最后他也承认：短期内没有理由指望低市盈率的一对跑赢高市盈率的一对，市场看好的股票自带惯性；选择价值型而非魅力型投资，归根到底取决于投资者本人深思熟虑后的态度——这也是下一章的主题。

In this chapter we should like to present a sample of security analysis in operation. We have selected, more or less at random, four companies which are found successively on the New York Stock Exchange list. These are ELTRA Corp. (a merger of Electric Autolite and Mergenthaler Linotype enterprises), Emerson Electric Co. (a manufacturer of electric and electronic products), Emery Air Freight (a domestic forwarder of air freight), and Emhart Corp. (originally a maker of bottling machinery only, but now also in builders’ hardware).* There are some broad resemblances between the three manufacturing firms, but the differences will seem more significant. There should be sufficient variety in the financial and operating data to make the examination of interest.

security analysis in operation证券分析的实际运用（in operation 实际运作中）more or less at random多少有些随意地，近乎随机地successively相继地，一个接一个地（指在交易所名单上紧挨着）forwarder of air freight航空货运代理商（forwarder 货运代理）builders’ hardware建筑五金of interest有意思的，值得关注的

本章展示证券分析的实际样本。我们近乎随机选了纽交所名单中连续出现的四家公司：ELTRA（电气自动照明与莫根塔勒排字机企业合并而成）、艾默生电气（电气和电子产品制造商）、埃默里航空货运（美国国内航空货运代理）和埃姆哈特（原只生产装瓶机械，后来也做建筑五金）。三家制造企业有一些大体相似处，但差异更重要；财务和经营数据足够多样，值得检视。

In Table 13-1 we present a summary of what the four companies were selling for in the market at the end of 1970, and a few figures on their 1970 operations. We then detail certain key ratios, which relate on the one hand to performance and on the other to price. Comment is called for on how various aspects of the performance pattern agree with the relative price pattern. Finally, we shall pass the four companies in review, suggesting some comparisons and relationships and evaluating each in terms of the requirements of a conservative common-stock investor.

The most striking fact about the four companies is that the current price/earnings ratios vary much more widely than their operating performance or financial condition. Two of the enterprises—ELTRA and Emhart—were modestly priced at only 9.7 times and 12 times the average earnings for 1968–1970, as against a similar figure of 15.5 times for the DJIA. The other two—Emerson and Emery—showed very high multiples of 33 and 45 times such earnings. There is bound to be some explanation of a difference such as this, and it is found in the superior growth of the favored companies’ profits in recent years, especially by the freight forwarder. (But the growth figures of the other two firms were not unsatisfactory.)

price/earnings ratios市盈率modestly priced定价不高，估值适中as against相比之下，与……相对multiples市盈率倍数（本书中 multiple 指股价是盈利的多少倍）There is bound to be必定有，肯定存在not unsatisfactory并非不能令人满意（双重否定，即“还算不错”）

最醒目的事实是，四家公司当前市盈率的差异，远大于经营表现或财务状况的差异。ELTRA和埃姆哈特价格温和，只有1968—1970年平均盈利的9.7倍和12倍，道指同口径为15.5倍；艾默生和埃默里则高达33倍和45倍。差别必有解释，主要是受青睐公司的近年利润增长更快，货运代理尤其如此。（另两家公司增长也不差。）

译者补充（非原文）：市盈率差距是市场为增长和确定性支付的价格。关键不是高增长是否存在，而是它能否持续到足以补回多付的倍数。

For more comprehensive treatment let us review briefly the chief elements of performance as they appear from our figures.

comprehensive treatment全面的论述（treatment 此处指“处理、论述”）chief elements主要要素

为更全面处理，下面按数据简要审视主要表现因素。

1. Profitability. (a) All the companies show satisfactory earnings on their book value, but the figures for Emerson and Emery are much higher than for the other two. A high rate of return on invested capital often goes along with a high annual growth rate in earnings per share.* All the companies except Emery showed better earnings on book value in 1969 than in 1961; but the Emery figure was exceptionally large in both years. (b) For manufacturing companies, the profit figure per dollar of sales is usually an indication of comparative strength or weakness. We use here the “ratio of operating income to sales,” as given in Standard & Poor’s Listed Stock Reports. Here again the results are satisfactory for all four companies, with an especially impressive showing by Emerson. The changes between 1961 and 1969 vary considerably among the companies.

Profitability盈利能力earnings on their book value相对于账面价值的盈利（即净资产收益率）return on invested capital投入资本回报率per dollar of sales每一美元销售额（所对应的利润）ratio of operating income to sales营业利润与销售额之比（即营业利润率）Listed Stock Reports《上市股票报告》（标准普尔出版的公司资料）showing表现（名词）

一、盈利能力。（a）四家公司账面价值回报都令人满意，艾默生和埃默里远高于另两家。投入资本回报率高，往往伴随每股盈利年增长率高。除埃默里外，其他公司1969年账面价值回报都高于1961年；埃默里两年都格外高。（b）对制造企业，每美元销售额利润通常能显示相对强弱。这里采用标普《上市股票报告》的营业利润／销售额比率；四家都合格，艾默生尤其出色。1961到1969年的变化则差异很大。

2. Stability. This we measure by the maximum decline in per-share earnings in any one of the past ten years, as against the average of the three preceding years. No decline translates into 100% stability, and this was registered by the two popular concerns. But the shrinkages of ELTRA and Emhart were quite moderate in the “poor year” 1970, amounting to only 8% each by our measurement, against 7% for the DJIA.

This we measure by the maximum decline in per-share earnings in any one of the past ten years, as against the average of the three preceding years.

我们用这样的指标来衡量稳定性：过去十年中任何一年的每股收益，相对于其前三年平均值的最大跌幅。

This 是 measure 的宾语，提到句首作强调（正常语序是 We measure this by…）；as against 意为“相对于、与……相比”，说明跌幅的比较基准是前三年的平均值。

二、稳定性。我们用过去十年任何一年每股盈利相对前三年平均的最大跌幅衡量。没有下跌即稳定性100%，两家热门公司做到这一点。ELTRA和埃姆哈特在糟糕的1970年也只各下降8%，道指为7%，幅度相当温和。

3. Growth. The two low-multiplier companies show quite satisfactory growth rates, in both cases doing better than the Dow Jones group. The ELTRA figures are especially impressive when set against its low price/earnings ratio. The growth is of course more impressive for the high-multiplier pair.

low-multiplier低市盈率的（multiplier = 市盈率）set against与……对照the high-multiplier pair高市盈率的那两家

三、增长。两家低倍数公司的增长率都相当满意，并都胜过道指；ELTRA结合其低市盈率尤其亮眼。高倍数组合的增长当然更突出。

4. Financial Position. The three manufacturing companies are in sound financial condition, having better than the standard ratio of $2 of current assets for $1 of current liabilities. Emery Air Freight has a lower ratio; but it falls in a different category, and with its fine record it would have no problem raising needed cash. All the companies have relatively low long-term debt. “Dilution” note: Emerson Electric had $163 million of market value of low-dividend convertible preferred shares outstanding at the end of 1970. In our analysis we have made allowance for the dilution factor in the usual way by treating the preferred as if converted into common. This decreased recent earnings by about 10 cents per share, or some 4%.

sound稳健的，健全的current assets流动资产（下文 current liabilities 流动负债）record业绩记录（本书常用义）Dilution稀释（可转换证券转股后摊薄每股收益）convertible preferred shares可转换优先股outstanding已发行在外的，流通中的（此处不是“杰出的”）made allowance for已考虑到，为……留出余地as if converted into common视同已转换为普通股

四、财务状况。三家制造公司财务稳健，流动资产／流动负债都好于2比1标准。埃默里比率较低，但业务类别不同，记录优秀，需要现金时不难筹集。四家公司长期债务都较低。摊薄方面：1970年末艾默生有市值1.63亿美元的低股息可转优先股。我们照常假定转换，近期每股盈利因此减少约10美分，即4%。

5. Dividends. What really counts is the history of continuance without interruption. The best record here is Emhart’s, which has not suspended a payment since 1902. ELTRA’S record is very good, Emerson’s quite satisfactory, Emery Freight is a newcomer. The variations in payout percentage do not seem especially significant. The current dividend yield is twice as high on the “cheap pair” as on the “dear pair,” corresponding to the price/earnings ratios.

What really counts真正重要的（count 此处指“重要、算数”）continuance without interruption不间断地持续（派息）payout percentage派息比率（股息占盈利的百分比）dividend yield股息收益率dear昂贵的（此处不是“亲爱的”）

五、股息。真正重要的是从未中断的历史。埃姆哈特最佳，自1902年起从未停付；ELTRA很好，艾默生相当满意，埃默里则是新人。派息比例差异似乎不重要。便宜组合当前股息率是昂贵组合两倍，与市盈率相呼应。

6. Price History. The reader should be impressed by the percentage advance shown in the price of all four of these issues, as measured from the lowest to the highest points during the past 34 years. (In all cases the low price has been adjusted for subsequent stock splits.) Note that for the DJIA the range from low to high was on the order of 11 to 1; for our companies the spread has varied from “only” 17 to 1 for Emhart to no less than 528 to 1 for Emery Air Freight.* These manifold price advances are characteristic of most of our older common-stock issues, and they proclaim the great opportunities of profit that have existed in the stock markets of the past. (But they may indicate also how overdone were the declines in the bear markets before 1950 when the low prices were registered.) Both ELTRA and Emhart sustained price shrinkages of more than 50% in the 1969–70 price break. Emerson and Emery had serious, but less distressing, declines; the former rebounded to a new all-time high before the end of 1970, the latter in early 1971.

六、价格历史。过去34年，四只股票从最低到最高的涨幅都很惊人（低价均按后来拆股调整）。道指高低约11比1；四家公司从埃姆哈特“仅”17比1，到埃默里高达528比1。老牌普通股常有这种数倍上涨，说明过去股市确有巨大获利机会；也可能说明1950年前熊市低点跌得过头。1969—1970年暴跌中，ELTRA和埃姆哈特都缩水逾50%；艾默生和埃默里也严重下跌但较轻，前者1970年末前、后者1971年初已反弹创新高。

General Observations on the Four Companies

对四家公司的总体观察

Emerson Electric has an enormous total market value, dwarfing the other three companies combined.* It is one of our “good-will giants,” to be commented on later. A financial analyst blessed (or handicapped) with a good memory will think of an analogy between Emerson Electric and Zenith Radio, and that would not be reassuring. For Zenith had a brilliant growth record for many years; it too sold in the market for $1.7 billion (in 1966); but its profits fell from $43 million in 1968 to only half as much in 1970, and in that year’s big selloff its price declined to 22½ against the previous top of 89. High valuations entail high risks.

艾默生电气总市值巨大，超过另三家合计很多，是后文所说的“商誉巨人”。记忆好的分析师会联想到艾默生与真力时收音机，结论并不安心。真力时多年增长辉煌，1966年市值也达17亿美元；利润却从1968年4300万美元降到1970年一半，当年抛售中股价从此前89跌至22.5。高估值伴随高风险。

Emery Air Freight must be the most promising of the four companies in terms of future growth, if the price/earnings ratio of nearly 40 times its highest reported earnings is to be even partially justified. The past growth, of course, has been most impressive. But these figures may not be so significant for the future if we consider that they started quite small, at only $570,000 of net earnings in 1958. It often proves much more difficult to continue to grow at a high rate after volume and profits have already expanded to big totals. The most surprising aspect of Emery’s story is that its earnings and market price continued to grow apace in 1970, which was the worst year in the domestic air-passenger industry. This is a remarkable achievement indeed, but it raises the question whether future profits may not be vulnerable to adverse developments, through increased competition, pressure for new arrangements between forwarders and airlines, etc. An elaborate study might be needed before a sound judgment could be passed on these points, but the conservative investor cannot leave them out of his general reckoning.

若接近40倍历史最高盈利的市盈率还要有一点合理性，埃默里必定是四家中未来增长最可期者。过去增长确实惊人，但起点很小：1958年净利仅57万美元。规模和利润已经很大后，维持高增长通常困难得多。更惊人的是，1970年美国国内航空客运业最糟，埃默里盈利和市价仍快速增长。这成就非凡，也让人追问：未来利润会不会因竞争加剧、货代与航空公司安排变化等不利因素而脆弱？作出稳健判断也许要深入研究，保守投资者不能忽略。

Emhart and ELTRA. Emhart has done better in its business than in the stock market over the past 14 years. In 1958 it sold as high as 22 times the current earnings—about the same ratio as for the DJIA. Since then its profits tripled, as against a rise of less than 100% for the Dow, but its closing price in 1970 was only a third above the 1958 high, versus 43% for the Dow. The record of ELTRA is somewhat similar. It appears that neither of these companies possesses glamour, or “sex appeal,” in the present market; but in all the statistical data they show up surprisingly well. Their future prospects? We have no sage remarks to make here, but this is what Standard & Poor’s had to say about the four companies in 1971:

Conclusions: Many financial analysts will find Emerson and Emery more interesting and appealing stocks than the other two—primarily, perhaps, because of their better “market action,” and secondarily because of their faster recent growth in earnings. Under our principles of conservative investment the first is not a valid reason for selection—that is something for the speculators to play around with. The second has validity, but within limits. Can the past growth and the presumably good prospects of Emery Air Freight justify a price more than 60 times its recent earnings?1 Our answer would be: Maybe for someone who has made an in-depth study of the possibilities of this company and come up with exceptionally firm and optimistic conclusions. But not for the careful investor who wants to be reasonably sure in advance that he is not committing the typical Wall Street error of overenthusiasm for good performance in earnings and in the stock market.* The same cautionary statements seem called for in the case of Emerson Electric, with a special reference to the market’s current valuation of over a billion dollars for the intangible, or earning-power, factor here. We should add that the “electronics industry,” once a fair-haired child of the stock market, has in general fallen on disastrous days. Emerson is an outstanding exception, but it will have to continue to be such an exception for a great many years in the future before the 1970 closing price will have been fully justified by its subsequent performance.

结论：许多分析师会觉得艾默生和埃默里比另两家更有趣、更吸引，首要原因也许是市场走势较好，其次是近期盈利增长更快。按保守投资原则，第一条不是有效选股理由，只适合投机者；第二条有道理，但有限度。埃默里的过去增长和良好前景，能否支持超过近期盈利60倍的价格？也许可以，但只适合深入研究并形成格外坚定乐观结论的人；不适合希望事先相当确定自己没有犯华尔街典型错误、因盈利和股价表现好而过度兴奋的谨慎投资者。艾默生也需同样警告，尤其市场给其无形资产或盈利能力估值超过10亿美元。曾是股市宠儿的电子行业整体已陷入灾难，艾默生是突出例外；未来很多年必须继续例外，1970年末价格才算被后来表现充分证明。

By contrast, both ELTRA at 27 and Emhart at 33 have the earmarks of companies with sufficient value behind their price to constitute reasonably protected investments. Here the investor can, if he wishes, consider himself basically a part owner of these businesses, at a cost corresponding to what the balance sheet shows to be the money invested therein.* The rate of earnings on invested capital has long been satisfactory; the stability of profits also; the past growth rate surprisingly so. The two companies will meet our seven statistical requirements for inclusion in a defensive investor’s portfolio. These will be developed in the next chapter, but we summarize them as follows:

Here the investor can, if he wishes, consider himself basically a part owner of these businesses, at a cost corresponding to what the balance sheet shows to be the money invested therein.

在这里，投资者如果愿意，可以把自己看作这些企业的部分所有者，而他付出的代价，与资产负债表上显示的投入这些企业的资金大致相当。

相反，27美元的ELTRA和33美元的埃姆哈特，价格背后似乎有足够价值，构成保护相当合理的投资。投资者可把自己看成企业部分所有者，成本接近资产负债表显示的投入资本。资本回报长期满意，利润稳定，过去增长也出乎意料地好。两家公司符合防御型组合的七项统计要求，下一章详述，这里概括如下：

  1. Adequate size.

We make no predictions about the future earnings performance of ELTRA or Emhart. In the investor’s diversified list of common stocks there are bound to be some that prove disappointing, and this may be the case for one or both of this pair. But the diversified list itself, based on the above principles of selection, plus whatever other sensible criteria the investor may wish to apply, should perform well enough across the years. At least, long experience tells us so.

diversified list分散化的持股清单（list 此处指投资组合）are bound to be必定会有prove disappointing结果令人失望（prove 作系动词）sensible criteria合理的标准across the years历经多年

我们不预测ELTRA或埃姆哈特未来盈利。分散股票名单中必有令人失望者，两家之一或两家都可能如此；但依上述原则和投资者愿意加入的其他合理标准构建的分散名单，多年下来应表现足够好，长期经验至少如此。

A final observation: An experienced security analyst, even if he accepted our general reasoning on these four companies, would have hesitated to recommend that a holder of Emerson or Emery exchange his shares for ELTRA or Emhart at the end of 1970—unless the holder understood clearly the philosophy behind the recommendation. There was no reason to expect that in any short period of time the low-multiplier duo would outperform the high-multipliers. The latter were well thought of in the market and thus had a considerable degree of momentum behind them, which might continue for an indefinite period. The sound basis for preferring ELTRA and Emhart to Emerson and Emery would be the client’s considered conclusion that he preferred value-type investments to glamour-type investments. Thus, to a substantial extent, common-stock investment policy must depend on the attitude of the individual investor. This approach is treated at greater length in our next chapter.

A final observation: An experienced security analyst, even if he accepted our general reasoning on these four companies, would have hesitated to recommend that a holder of Emerson or Emery exchange his shares for ELTRA or Emhart at the end of 1970—unless the holder understood clearly the philosophy behind the recommendation.

最后一点：一位有经验的证券分析师，即便接受我们对这四家公司的总体论证，在 1970 年末也会犹豫要不要建议持有艾默生或埃默里股票的人换成 ELTRA 或埃姆哈特——除非持有者清楚地理解这一建议背后的理念。

主干是 An experienced security analyst … would have hesitated to recommend…，中间的 even if 从句是插入的让步状语；recommend that a holder … exchange 用的是虚拟语气（动词原形 exchange，不加 -s）；would have hesitated 表示对过去情形的假设性判断。

最后一点：有经验的分析师即使接受上述推理，1970年末也会犹豫是否建议艾默生或埃默里持有人换成ELTRA或埃姆哈特，除非客户清楚理解背后理念。没有理由期待短期内低倍数组合跑赢高倍数组合；后者市场评价高，有很强动量，可能持续很久。偏好ELTRA和埃姆哈特的稳健理由，是客户经过思考后选择价值型而非魅力型投资。因此普通股政策很大程度上取决于个人态度，下一章会详谈。

Notes · 注释（贾森·兹威格）

* Of Graham’s four examples, only Emerson Electric still exists in the same form. ELTRA Corp. is no longer an independent company; it merged with Bunker Ramo Corp. in the 1970s, putting it in the business of supplying stock quotes to brokerage firms across an early network of computers. What remains of ELTRA’s operations is now part of Honeywell Corp. The firm formerly known as Emery Air Freight is now a division of CNF Inc. Emhart Corp. was acquired by Black & Decker Corp. in 1989.
四家公司中，只有艾默生电气仍以原形存在。ELTRA在70年代与Bunker Ramo合并，进入早期电脑网络向券商提供报价的业务，残余业务现属霍尼韦尔；埃默里航空货运现为CNF的部门；埃姆哈特1989年被百得收购。
* This measure is captured in the line “Net per share/book value” in Table 13-2, which measures the companies’ net income as a percentage of their tangible book value.
表13-2“每股净利／账面价值”一行体现该指标，即净利润占有形账面价值的百分比。
* In each case, Graham is referring to Section C of Table 13-2 and dividing the high price during the 1936–1968 period by the low price. For example, Emery’s high price of 66 divided by its low price of 1/8 equals 528, or a ratio of 528 to 1 between the high and low.
格雷厄姆均用表13-2 C部分1936—1968年高价除以低价。例如埃默里66美元除以1/8美元等于528，高低比528比1。
* At the end of 1970, Emerson’s $1.6 billion in market value truly was “enormous,” given average stock sizes at the time. At year-end 2002, Emerson’s common stock had a total market value of approximately $21 billion.
1970年末，按当时平均股票规模，艾默生16亿美元市值确实“巨大”；2002年末约为210亿美元。
* Graham was right. Of the “Nifty Fifty” stocks that were most fashionable and highly valued in 1972, Emery fared among the worst. The March 1, 1982, issue of Forbes reported that since 1972 Emery had lost 72.8% of its value after inflation. By late 1974, according to the investment researchers at the Leuthold Group in Minneapolis, Emery’s stock had already fallen 58% and its price/earnings ratio had plummeted from 64 times to just 15. The “overenthusiasm” Graham had warned against was eviscerated in short order. Can the passage of time make up for this kind of excess? Not always: Leuthold calculated that $1000 invested in Emery in 1972 would be worth only $839 as of 1999. It’s likely that the people who overpaid for Internet stocks in the late 1990s will not break even for decades—if ever (see the commentary on Chapter 20).
格雷厄姆是对的。1972年最时髦、估值最高的“漂亮50”中，埃默里表现最差之一。经通胀调整，1972到1982年价值损失72.8%；1974年末股价已跌58%，市盈率从64倍崩至15倍。1972年投入1000美元，到1999年也只值839美元。90年代末高价买互联网股的人，可能几十年乃至永远无法回本。
* Graham’s point is that, based on their prices at the time, an investor could buy shares in these two companies for little more than their book value, as shown in the third line of Section B in Table 13-2.
格雷厄姆的意思是，按当时价格，买两家公司只比表13-2 B部分第三行所列账面价值略贵。

Stock Selection for the Defensive Investor

Chapter 14Stock Selection for the Defensive Investor第14章 防御型投资者的股票选择

本章导读这一章把证券分析技术落实到防御型投资者的选股上。格雷厄姆先给出两条路：一是“道指型”组合，把道琼斯工业平均指数的 30 只成分股全部买下（或买几只有代表性的基金）；二是用一套量化标准逐只筛选。筛选的核心是七条标准：企业规模足够大（工业公司年销售额不低于 1 亿美元）、财务状况稳健（流动比率至少 2:1，长期债务不超过营运资本）、过去十年每年都有盈利、至少 20 年不间断派息、十年内每股收益至少增长三分之一、市盈率不超过过去三年平均收益的 15 倍、股价不超过账面价值的 1.5 倍——后两条可以合并成“市盈率 × 市净率不超过 22.5”这条经验法则。他随后把这套标准套在 1970 年末的道指上：整体勉强及格，逐只检验却只有 5 家全部通过；转到公用事业股，情况宽松得多，所以他称之为防御型投资者的“解决方案”。金融股和铁路股各占一小节：前者只需套用同样的价格标准，后者因为竞争和管制而没有非买不可的理由。最后一节是本章的思想部分：他把证券分析分成“预测”（定性）和“保护”（定量）两条路线，坦承自己始终站在定量一边，并得出结论——既然当前价格已经反映了已知事实和普遍预期，挑“最好的股票”本质上充满争议，防御型投资者应当放下这件事，把分散化放在个股选择之上。

It is time to turn to some broader applications of the techniques of security analysis. Since we have already described in general terms the investment policies recommended for our two categories of investors,* it would be logical for us now to indicate how security analysis comes into play in order to implement these policies. The defensive investor who follows our suggestions will purchase only high-grade bonds plus a diversified list of leading common stocks. He is to make sure that the price at which he bought the latter is not unduly high as judged by applicable standards.

security analysis证券分析comes into play发挥作用，派上用场high-grade高等级的unduly过分地，不适当地applicable standards适用的标准

现在把证券分析技术用于更广范围。前面已概述两类投资者的政策，接下来说明如何用分析落实。防御型投资者按建议只买高等级债券和分散的领先普通股，并按适用标准确认买价不过高。

In setting up this diversified list he has a choice of two approaches, the DJIA-type of portfolio and the quantitatively-tested portfolio. In the first he acquires a true cross-section sample of the leading issues, which will include both some favored growth companies, whose shares sell at especially high multipliers, and also less popular and less expensive enterprises. This could be done, most simply perhaps, by buying the same amounts of all thirty of the issues in the DowJones Industrial Average (DJIA). Ten shares of each, at the 900 level for the average, would cost an aggregate of about $16,000.1 On the basis of the past record he might expect approximately the same future results by buying shares of several representative investment funds.†

quantitatively-tested经过量化检验的cross-section sample横截面样本（各类都有的代表性样本）leading issues龙头股（issue 在本书中指证券、股票）multipliers市盈率（本书用法）aggregate总额representative investment funds有代表性的投资基金

建立分散名单有两种办法：道指型组合或量化筛选组合。前者选取领先股票的真正横截面，既有高倍数热门成长公司，也有较冷门便宜企业。最简单是等额买入道指30只成分股；指数900点时每只买10股，合计约1.6万美元。按过去记录，买几只代表性投资基金，未来结果可能相近。

His second choice would be to apply a set of standards to each purchase, to make sure that he obtains (1) a minimum of quality in the past performance and current financial position of the company, and also (2) a minimum of quantity in terms of earnings and assets per dollar of price. At the close of the previous chapter we listed seven such quality and quantity criteria suggested for the selection of specific common stocks. Let us describe them in order.

a set of standards一套标准financial position财务状况in terms of就……而言，以……衡量per dollar of price每一美元价格所对应的criteria标准（criterion 的复数）

第二种办法是逐只应用标准，确保公司过去表现和当前财务状况达到最低质量，同时每一美元价格买到的盈利与资产达到最低数量。上一章末列出七项标准，下面依次说明。

1. Adequate Size of the Enterprise

1. 足够的企业规模

All our minimum figures must be arbitrary and especially in the matter of size required. Our idea is to exclude small companies which may be subject to more than average vicissitudes especially in the industrial field. (There are often good possibilities in such enterprises but we do not consider them suited to the needs of the defensive investor.) Let us use round amounts: not less than $100 million of annual sales for an industrial company and, not less than $50 million of total assets for a public utility.

arbitrary主观设定的，武断的be subject to容易遭受vicissitudes变迁，兴衰起伏round amounts整数public utility公用事业公司

所有最低数字都难免武断，规模尤其如此。目的在排除更容易遭遇异常波折的小公司，工业领域更明显。（其中常有好机会，但不适合防御型投资者。）取整标准：工业公司年销售额不少于1亿美元，公用事业总资产不少于5000万美元。

2. A Sufficiently Strong Financial Condition

2. 足够稳健的财务状况

For industrial companies current assets should be at least twice current liabilities—a so-called two-to-one current ratio. Also, long-term debt should not exceed the net current assets (or “working capital”). For public utilities the debt should not exceed twice the stock equity (at book value).

two-to-one current ratio2 比 1 的流动比率（流动资产 current assets 是流动负债 current liabilities 的两倍）working capital营运资本（即净流动资产）stock equity股东权益

工业公司流动资产至少为流动负债两倍，即2比1流动比率；长期债务还不得超过净流动资产（营运资本）。公用事业债务不得超过账面股东权益两倍。

3. Earnings Stability

3. 盈利稳定

Some earnings for the common stock in each of the past ten years.

Some earnings有一些盈利（即不亏损）

过去十年每年普通股都应有盈利。

4. Dividend Record

4. 股息记录

Uninterrupted payments for at least the past 20 years.

Uninterrupted不间断的

至少过去二十年持续派息。

5. Earnings Growth

5. 盈利增长

A minimum increase of at least one-third in per-share earnings in the past ten years using three-year averages at the beginning and end.

per-share earnings每股收益three-year averages三年平均值

以期初、期末三年平均比较，过去十年每股盈利至少增长三分之一。

6. Moderate Price/Earnings Ratio

6. 适度的市盈率

Current price should not be more than 15 times average earnings of the past three years.

15 times average earnings平均收益的 15 倍（即市盈率不超过 15）

当前股价不超过过去三年平均盈利15倍。

7. Moderate Ratio of Price to Assets

7. 适度的股价与资产比率（市净率）

Current price should not be more than 1½ times the book value last reported. However, a multiplier of earnings below 15 could justify a correspondingly higher multiplier of assets. As a rule of thumb we suggest that the product of the multiplier times the ratio of price to book value should not exceed 22.5. (This figure corresponds to 15 times earnings and 1½ times book value. It would admit an issue selling at only 9 times earnings and 2.5 times asset value, etc.)

book value last reported最近一次报告的账面价值multiplier of earnings盈利乘数，即市盈率rule of thumb经验法则the product of……的乘积admit允许……纳入（此处不是“承认”）

当前股价不超过最近账面价值1.5倍。不过，盈利倍数低于15可允许资产倍数相应提高。经验法则是市盈率与市净率乘积不超过22.5；它对应15倍盈利和1.5倍账面价值，也允许9倍盈利、2.5倍资产等组合。

译者补充（非原文）：可写成格雷厄姆数：最高合理价格≈√(22.5×每股盈利×每股账面价值)。它只把两项上限合成筛选线，不是精确内在价值。

GENERAL COMMENTS: These requirements are set up especially for the needs and the temperament of defensive investors. They will eliminate the great majority of common stocks as candidates for the portfolio, and in two opposite ways. On the one hand they will exclude companies that are (1) too small, (2) in relatively weak financial condition, (3) with a deficit stigma in their ten-year record, and (4) not having a long history of continuous dividends. Of these tests the most severe under recent financial conditions are those of financial strength. A considerable number of our large and formerly strongly entrenched enterprises have weakened their current ratio or overexpanded their debt, or both, in recent years.

temperament性情，气质eliminate淘汰，排除deficit stigma亏损的污点（deficit 亏损；stigma 污名）severe严格的strongly entrenched地位稳固的overexpanded过度扩张

总体评论：这些要求专为防御型投资者的需要和性情设计，会从两个相反方向淘汰绝大多数普通股。一边排除规模太小、财务较弱、十年记录有亏损、或缺乏长期连续股息的公司。近期环境下最严的是财务实力；不少过去根基牢固的大企业近年流动比率恶化、债务扩张过度，或两者兼有。

Our last two criteria are exclusive in the opposite direction, by demanding more earnings and more assets per dollar of price than the popular issues will supply. This is by no means the standard viewpoint of financial analysts; in fact most will insist that even conservative investors should be prepared to pay generous prices for stocks of the choice companies. We have expounded our contrary view above; it rests largely on the absence of an adequate factor of safety when too large a portion of the price must depend on ever-increasing earnings in the future. The reader will have to decide this important question for himself—after weighing the arguments on both sides.

exclusive起排除作用的generous prices高价（generous 此处指“慷慨的、偏高的”）choice companies优质公司（choice 作形容词：上等的）expounded详细阐述rests largely on主要建立在……之上factor of safety安全系数

最后两项则从另一方向排除热门股，因为要求每美元价格买到更多盈利和资产。这并非分析师主流观点，多数人坚持即使保守投资者也应为优质公司慷慨出价。我们的相反立场主要基于：若价格很大部分依赖未来盈利不断增长，就缺乏足够安全因素。读者应权衡双方论据后自己决定。

We have nonetheless opted for the inclusion of a modest requirement of growth over the past decade. Without it the typical company would show retrogression, at least in terms of profit per dollar of invested capital. There is no reason for the defensive investor to include such companies—though if the price is low enough they could qualify as bargain opportunities.

opted for选择了retrogression倒退qualify as够得上，有资格算作bargain opportunities廉价买入的机会

我们仍加入了过去十年温和增长要求；否则典型公司至少按每美元投入资本利润计算会倒退。防御型投资者没理由纳入这类公司，但价格足够低时，它们可能成为便宜机会。

The suggested maximum figure of 15 times earnings might well result in a typical portfolio with an average multiplier of, say, 12 to 13 times. Note that in February 1972 American Tel. & Tel. sold at 11 times its three-year (and current) earnings, and Standard Oil of California at less than 10 times latest earnings. Our basic recommendation is that the stock portfolio, when acquired, should have an overall earnings/price ratio—the reverse of the P/E ratio—at least as high as the current high-grade bond rate. This would mean a P/E ratio no higher than 13.3 against an AA bond yield of 7.5%.*

Our basic recommendation is that the stock portfolio, when acquired, should have an overall earnings/price ratio—the reverse of the P/E ratio—at least as high as the current high-grade bond rate.

我们的基本建议是：股票组合在买入时，其整体的收益价格比——也就是市盈率的倒数——至少应当不低于当时高等级债券的利率。

把我们的标准应用于 1970 年末的道琼斯工业平均指数

Our application of specific criteria to this select group of industrial stocks indicates that the number meeting every one of our tests will be a relatively small percentage of all listed industrial issues. We hazard the guess that about 100 issues of this sort could have been found in the Standard & Poor’s Stock Guide at the end of 1970, just about enough to provide the investor with a satisfactory range of personal choice.*

The Public-Utility “Solution”

公用事业股这一“解决方案”

If we turn now to the field of public-utility stocks we find a much more comfortable and inviting situation for the investor.† Here the vast majority of issues appear to be cut out, by their performance record and their price ratios, in accordance with the defensive investor’s needs as we judge them. We exclude one criterion from our tests of public-utility stocks—namely, the ratio of current assets to current liabilities. The working-capital factor takes care of itself in this industry as part of the continuous financing of its growth by sales of bonds and shares. We do require an adequate proportion of stock capital to debt.4

inviting诱人的cut out天生适合（be cut out for）in accordance with符合namely即takes care of itself自然会解决，不必操心stock capital股本

Here the vast majority of issues appear to be cut out, by their performance record and their price ratios, in accordance with the defensive investor’s needs as we judge them.

在这个领域，绝大多数股票凭其业绩记录和价格比率，看起来天生就符合我们所理解的防御型投资者的需要。

be cut out (for) 是习语，意为“天生适合”，这里接 in accordance with；两个逗号之间的 by their performance record and their price ratios 是插入的方式状语，读时可先跳过；as we judge them 修饰 needs，意为“按我们的判断”。

转向公用事业股，情况舒适得多、也更吸引。按表现记录和价格比率，绝大多数似乎都符合我们判断的防御型需要。测试公用事业时去掉流动比率，因为该行业通过持续发行债券和股票为增长融资，营运资本会自行处理；但仍要求股本相对债务比例充足。

In Table 14-4 we present a résumé of the 15 issues in the Dow Jones public-utility average. For comparison, Table 14-5 gives a similar picture of a random selection of fifteen other utilities taken from the New York Stock Exchange list.

résumé摘要，概要（法语借词，此处不是“简历”）random selection随机选出的一组

表14-4概括道琼斯公用事业平均指数15只股票；表14-5随机选取纽交所另外15家公用事业作类似比较。

As 1972 began the defensive investor could have had quite a wide choice of utility common stocks, each of which would have met our requirements for both performance and price. These companies offered him everything he had a right to demand from simply chosen common-stock investments. In comparison with prominent industrial companies as represented by the DJIA, they offered almost as good a record of past growth, plus smaller fluctuations in the annual figures—both at a lower price in relation to earnings and assets. The dividend return was significantly higher. The position of the utilities as regulated monopolies is assuredly more of an advantage than a disadvantage for the conservative investor. Under law they are entitled to charge rates sufficiently remunerative to attract the capital they need for their continuous expansion, and this implies adequate offsets to inflated costs. While the process of regulation has often been cumbersome and perhaps dilatory, it has not prevented the utilities from earning a fair return on their rising invested capital over many decades.

had a right to demand有权要求dividend return股息收益率regulated monopolies受管制的垄断企业assuredly无疑地entitled to有权remunerative有利可图的，回报足够的offsets抵消cumbersome繁琐的dilatory拖沓的a fair return合理的回报

1972年初，防御型投资者可广泛选择同时符合表现和价格要求的公用事业普通股。这些公司提供了简单选股有权要求的一切。与道指代表的知名工业公司相比，过去增长几乎同样好，年度波动更小，价格相对盈利和资产更低，股息率明显更高。受监管垄断对保守投资者利大于弊。法律允许其收取足以吸引持续扩张所需资本的费率，意味着能抵销通胀成本；监管虽常笨重迟缓，几十年里仍未妨碍公用事业对不断增加的资本取得公平回报。

For the defensive investor the central appeal of the public-utility stocks at this time should be their availability at a moderate price in relation to book value. This means that he can ignore stockmarket considerations, if he wishes, and consider himself primarily as a part owner of well-established and well-earning businesses. The market quotations are always there for him to take advantage of when times are propitious—either for purchases at unusually attractive low levels, or for sales when their prices seem definitely too high.

availability可得性，能买得到part owner部分所有者（即股东）well-earning盈利良好的market quotations市场报价propitious时机有利的

当时公用事业股对防御型投资者的核心吸引力，是相对账面价值价格温和。因此，他可不理股市，把自己主要看成成熟且盈利良好企业的部分所有者；市场报价始终在那里，低得格外诱人时买，高得明显过分时卖。

The market record of the public-utility indexes—condensed in Table 14-6, along with those of other groups—indicates that there have been ample possibilities of profit in these investments in the past. While the rise has not been as great as in the industrial index, the individual utilities have shown more price stability in most periods than have other groups.* It is striking to observe in this table that the relative price/earnings ratios of the industrials and the utilities have changed places during the past two decades. These reversals will have more meaning for the active than for the passive investor. But they suggest that even defensive portfolios should be changed from time to time, especially if the securities purchased have an apparently excessive advance and can be replaced by issues much more reasonably priced. Alas! there will be capital-gains taxes to pay—which for the typical investor seems to be about the same as the Devil to pay. Our old ally, experience, tells us here that it is better to sell and pay the tax than not sell and repent.

表14-6概括公用事业及其他指数，说明过去获利机会充足。涨幅虽不如工业指数，多数时期个别公用事业价格更稳定。表中工业与公用事业相对市盈率在二十年间互换位置，主动投资者更应重视；但也提示防御型组合偶尔应调整，尤其持仓涨得显然过度、可换成价格合理得多的证券时。可惜要付资本利得税，对普通投资者仿佛“要命”。经验告诉我们，宁可卖出纳税，也别不卖后悔。

Investing in Stocks of Financial Enterprises

投资金融企业的股票

A considerable variety of concerns may be ranged under the rubric of “financial companies.” These would include banks, insurance companies, savings and loan associations, credit and small-loan companies, mortgage companies, and “investment companies” (e.g., mutual funds).* It is characteristic of all these enterprises that they have a relatively small part of their assets in the form of material things—such as fixed assets and merchandise inventories—but on the other hand most categories have short-term obligations well in excess of their stock capital. The question of financial soundness is, therefore, more relevant here than in the case of the typical manufacturing or commercial enterprise. This, in turn, has given rise to various forms of regulation and supervision, with the design and general result of assuring against unsound financial practices.

concerns企业，公司（本书常用义）ranged under the rubric of归在……的名目之下savings and loan associations储蓄贷款协会merchandise inventories商品存货short-term obligations短期债务well in excess of远超过assuring against防止，确保不发生

“金融公司”包括银行、保险、储贷协会、信贷和小额贷款公司、抵押公司与投资公司（如共同基金）。共同特点是实物资产（固定资产、存货）占比小，多数类别短期负债却远超股本。因此财务稳健性比典型制造或商业企业更重要，也由此产生各种监管监督，目的和一般结果是防止不稳健做法。

Broadly speaking, the shares of financial concerns have produced investment results similar to those of other types of common shares. Table 14-7 shows price changes between 1948 and 1970 in six groups represented in the Standard & Poor’s stock-price indexes. The average for 1941–1943 is taken as 10, the base level. The year-end 1970 figures ranged between 44.3 for the 9 New York banks and 218 for the 11 life-insurance stocks. During the subintervals there was considerable variation in the respective price movements. For example, the New York City bank stocks did quite well between 1958 and 1968; conversely the spectacular life-insurance group actually lost ground between 1963 and 1968. These cross-movements are found in many, perhaps most, of the numerous industry groups in the Standard & Poor’s indexes.

广义看，金融股投资结果与其他普通股相似。表14-7列标普六个行业组1948—1970年价格变化，以1941—1943年平均为10。1970年末从纽约九家银行44.3到十一家寿险218不等；子期间走势差异很大。例如纽约银行股1958—1968年很好，耀眼的寿险组1963—1968年反而下跌。标普众多行业中常见这种交叉走势。

We have no very helpful remarks to offer in this broad area of investment—other than to counsel that the same arithmetical standards for price in relation to earnings and book value be applied to the choice of companies in these groups as we have suggested for industrial and public-utility investments.

other than除了counsel建议（动词）arithmetical standards算术标准（即数字化的定量标准）

对这个广阔领域，我们没有特别有用的意见，只建议选择时采用与工业和公用事业相同的算术标准，比较价格与盈利、账面价值。

Railroad Issues

铁路股

The railroad story is a far different one from that of the utilities. The carriers have suffered severely from a combination of severe competition and strict regulation. (Their labor-cost problem has of course been difficult as well, but that has not been confined to railroads.) Automobiles, buses, and airlines have drawn off most of their passenger business and left the rest highly unprofitable; the trucks have taken a good deal of their freight traffic. More than half of the railroad mileage of the country has been in bankruptcy (or “trusteeship”) at various times during the past 50 years.

carriers运输公司（此处指铁路公司）confined to局限于drawn off抽走，分流freight traffic货运业务railroad mileage铁路里程trusteeship托管（破产后由受托人接管）

铁路故事与公用事业大不相同。运输公司同时遭受激烈竞争和严格监管，劳动力成本也困难。汽车、客车和航空夺走大部分客运，剩余业务高度亏损；卡车又抢走大量货运。过去五十年，美国一半以上铁路里程曾在某时进入破产或托管。

But this half-century has not been all downhill for the carriers. There have been prosperous periods for the industry, especially the war years. Some of the lines have managed to maintain their earning power and their dividends despite the general difficulties.

all downhill一路走下坡lines铁路公司（line 指铁路线）

但这半世纪并非一路下坡，行业也有繁荣期，战时尤其如此；部分线路在整体困境中仍维持盈利和股息。

The Standard & Poor’s index advanced sevenfold from the low of 1942 to the high of 1968, not much below the percentage gain in the public-utility index. The bankruptcy of the Penn Central Transportation Co., our most important railroad, in 1970 shocked the financial world. Only a year and two years previously the stock sold at close to the highest price level in its long history, and it had paid continuous dividends for more than 120 years! (On p. 423 below we present a brief analysis of this railroad to illustrate how a competent student could have detected the developing weaknesses in the company’s picture and counseled against ownership of its securities.) The market level of railroad shares as a whole was seriously affected by this financial disaster.

标普铁路指数从1942年低点到1968年高点涨七倍，略低于公用事业。1970年最重要铁路宾夕法尼亚中央运输公司破产，震动金融界；此前一两年股价还接近长期最高，并连续派息逾120年！（第423页会简析，说明合格研究者如何发现弱点并反对持有。）灾难严重打击铁路股整体。

It is usually unsound to make blanket recommendations of whole classes of securities, and there are equal objections to broad condemnations. The record of railroad share prices in Table 14-6 shows that the group as a whole has often offered chances for a large profit. (But in our view the great advances were in themselves largely unwarranted.) Let us confine our suggestion to this: There is no compelling reason for the investor to own railroad shares; before he buys any he should make sure that he is getting so much value for his money that it would be unreasonable to look for something else instead.*

unsound不稳妥的blanket recommendations一刀切的推荐condemnations全盘否定，谴责unwarranted没有根据的confine our suggestion to把建议限定为compelling reason令人信服的理由，非做不可的理由

笼统推荐整类证券通常不稳健，全面谴责也一样。表14-6显示铁路股整体常提供巨大利润机会，尽管我们认为很多大涨本身缺乏依据。建议只限于：投资者没有非持有铁路股不可的理由；买前应确保价值多到选择别的证券反而不合理。

Selectivity for the Defensive Investor

防御型投资者的选股

Every investor would like his list to be better or more promising than the average. Hence the reader will ask whether, if he gets himself a competent adviser or security analyst, he should not be able to count on being supplied with an investment package of really superior merits. “After all,” he may say, “the rules you have outlined are pretty simple and easygoing. A highly trained analyst ought to be able to use all his skill and techniques to improve substantially on something as obvious as the Dow Jones list. If not, what good are all his statistics, calculations, and pontifical judgments?”

Hence the reader will ask whether, if he gets himself a competent adviser or security analyst, he should not be able to count on being supplied with an investment package of really superior merits.

因此读者会问：如果他给自己找一位称职的顾问或证券分析师，难道就不能指望得到一份真正出色的投资组合吗？

每个投资者都希望名单优于平均，于是会问：找一位称职顾问或分析师，难道不能得到真正优越的投资组合？“你们规则如此简单宽松，高度训练的分析师理应凭技能显著胜过显而易见的道指名单；否则统计、计算和权威判断有什么用？”

Suppose, as a practical test, we had asked a hundred security analysts to choose the “best” five stocks in the Dow Jones Average, to be bought at the end of 1970. Few would have come up with identical choices and many of the lists would have differed completely from each other.

实际测试一下：请一百位分析师挑选1970年末最值得买的五只道指股。几乎没人会选得完全一样，很多名单会彻底不同。

This is not so surprising as it may at first appear. The underlying reason is that the current price of each prominent stock pretty well reflects the salient factors in its financial record plus the general opinion as to its future prospects. Hence the view of any analyst that one stock is a better buy than the rest must arise to a great extent from his personal partialities and expectations, or from the placing of his emphasis on one set of factors rather than on another in his work of evaluation. If all analysts were agreed that one particular stock was better than all the rest, that issue would quickly advance to a price which would offset all of its previous advantages.*

Hence the view of any analyst that one stock is a better buy than the rest must arise to a great extent from his personal partialities and expectations, or from the placing of his emphasis on one set of factors rather than on another in his work of evaluation.

因此，任何一位分析师认为某只股票比其余股票更值得买的看法，必定在很大程度上来自他个人的偏好和预期，或者来自他在评估工作中把重点放在这一组因素而不是另一组因素上。

主语很长：the view of any analyst that …，其中 that 从句是 view 的同位语，说明“看法”的内容；谓语是 must arise from … or from …，两个 from 并列；the placing of his emphasis on A rather than on B 是名词化表达，相当于 placing his emphasis on A rather than on B。

这并不奇怪。每只知名股票的当前价格已经大体反映财务记录中的显著因素和市场对未来的普遍意见。分析师认为某股更好，很大程度只能来自个人偏好、预期，或估值时更强调某组因素。若所有分析师一致认为某股最佳，它很快会上涨到抵销原有优势的价格。

Our statement that the current price reflects both known facts and future expectations was intended to emphasize the double basis for market valuations. Corresponding with these two kinds of value elements are two basically different approaches to security analysis. To be sure, every competent analyst looks forward to the future rather than backward to the past, and he realizes that his work will prove good or bad depending on what will happen and not on what has happened. Nevertheless, the future itself can be approached in two different ways, which may be called the way of prediction (or projection) and the way of protection. *

double basis双重基础valuations估值Corresponding with与……相对应To be sure诚然prove good or bad结果证明是好是坏projection推测，外推

Corresponding with these two kinds of value elements are two basically different approaches to security analysis.

与这两类价值要素相对应的，是两种截然不同的证券分析方法。

这是把分词短语提前的完全倒装句：正常语序是 Two basically different approaches … are corresponding with these two kinds of value elements。真正的主语是句末的 two … approaches，谓语 are 随之放在了主语前面。

当前价格同时反映已知事实和未来预期，强调的是市场估值的双重基础。对应两类价值因素，证券分析有两种根本方法。称职分析师都面向未来，明白工作好坏取决于将来而非过去；但接近未来有两条路：预测（推演）和保护。

译者补充（非原文）：预测问“未来会多好”；保护问“即使没那么好，我付的价格能否承受”。格雷厄姆更偏向后者。

Those who emphasize prediction will endeavor to anticipate fairly accurately just what the company will accomplish in future years—in particular whether earnings will show pronounced and persistent growth. These conclusions may be based on a very careful study of such factors as supply and demand in the industry—or volume, price, and costs—or else they may be derived from a rather naïve projection of the line of past growth into the future. If these authorities are convinced that the fairly long-term prospects are unusually favorable, they will almost always recommend the stock for purchase without paying too much regard to the level at which it is selling. Such, for example, was the general attitude with respect to the air-transport stocks—an attitude that persisted for many years despite the distressingly bad results often shown after 1946. In the Introduction we have commented on the disparity between the strong price action and the relatively disappointing earnings record of this industry.
